form.label: CVE impact overview
form.description: New CVEs in Rapid7 (by date added; by default only CVEs published at most 90 days before Rapid7 added the check, so bulk re-adds of old checks are left out) with what they affect: software, vendor / platform, Rapid7 check platforms, and the OS and environments of your affected Active servers. Rollup checks (more than 20 CVEs) are left out unless included. Refreshed hourly by "Rapid7 CVE - recent checks lookup" (:20) and "recent hits lookup" (:30). Click a CVE to open it in CVE response.

input.label: Which CVEs
input.choice: New CVEs (published ≤ 90 days before Rapid7 added the check)
Also old CVEs re-added by Rapid7

search.query: | inputlookup r7_recent_checks.csv | search $f_sev$ $f_roll$ $f_fresh$ | eval a=substr(added,1,10), p=substr(published,1,10) | where ("$f_addfrom$"="" AND "$f_addto$"="" AND tonumber(added_e)>=relative_time(now(),"$f_win$")) OR (NOT ("$f_addfrom$"="" AND "$f_addto$"="") AND ("$f_addfrom$"="" OR a>="$f_addfrom$") AND ("$f_addto$"="" OR a<="$f_addto$")) | where ("$f_pubfrom$"="" OR p>="$f_pubfrom$") AND ("$f_pubto$"="" OR p<="$f_pubto$") AND coalesce(tonumber(cvss_v3),0)>=$f_cvss$ | eval cve=if(rollup=1, "ROLLUP:".vuln_id, split(cves_str,"|")) | mvexpand cve | where like(lower(cve), lower("%$f_cve$%")) AND like(lower(coalesce(title,"")), lower("%$f_title$%")) AND like(lower(coalesce(component,"")), lower("%$f_sw$%")) AND like(lower(coalesce(platform,"")." ".coalesce(check_platform,"")), lower("%$f_plat$%")) | stats values(vuln_id) as rapid7_checks values(check_platform) as check_platforms first(title) as title first(component) as software first(platform) as platform first(severity) as severity max(cvss_v3) as cvss_v3 min(p) as published min(a) as added max(rollup) as rollup by cve | join type=left cve [| inputlookup r7_recent_hits.csv | search cmdb_status="WORKING_ACTIVE" | stats dc(asset_id) as your_servers dc(eval(if(env_label="Prod · DC",asset_id,null()))) as prod_dc dc(eval(if(env_label="Prod · DR",asset_id,null()))) as prod_dr dc(eval(if(env_group="Non-prod",asset_id,null()))) as non_prod dc(eval(if(env_label="INFRA",asset_id,null()))) as infra values(os) as os_list by cve] | fillnull value=0 your_servers prod_dc prod_dr non_prod infra | eval os_list=mvjoin(os_list, "; ") | where like(lower(coalesce(os_list,"")), lower("%$f_os$%")) | eval sortp=prod_dc+prod_dr | sort - sortp - your_servers - cvss_v3 | fields - sortp

| inputlookup r7_recent_hits.csv | search cmdb_status="WORKING_ACTIVE" $f_sev$ $f_roll$ $f_fresh$ | eval a=strftime(added_e,"%Y-%m-%d"), p=substr(published,1,10) | where ("$f_addfrom$"="" AND "$f_addto$"="" AND tonumber(added_e)>=relative_time(now(),"$f_win$")) OR (NOT ("$f_addfrom$"="" AND "$f_addto$"="") AND ("$f_addfrom$"="" OR a>="$f_addfrom$") AND ("$f_addto$"="" OR a<="$f_addto$")) | where ("$f_pubfrom$"="" OR p>="$f_pubfrom$") AND ("$f_pubto$"="" OR p<="$f_pubto$") AND coalesce(tonumber(cvss_v3),0)>=$f_cvss$ | where like(lower(cve), lower("%$f_cve$%")) AND like(lower(coalesce(title,"")), lower("%$f_title$%")) AND like(lower(coalesce(component,"")), lower("%$f_sw$%")) AND like(lower(coalesce(platform,"")." ".coalesce(check_platform,"")), lower("%$f_plat$%")) AND like(lower(coalesce(os,"")), lower("%$f_os$%")) | stats dc(eval(if(env_group="Prod",asset_id,null()))) as prod dc(eval(if(env_label="Prod · DC",asset_id,null()))) as dc dc(eval(if(env_label="Prod · DR",asset_id,null()))) as dr dc(eval(if(env_group="Non-prod",asset_id,null()))) as nonprod dc(eval(if(env_label="INFRA",asset_id,null()))) as infra
`r7_latest(rapid7:vm:asset_site)` | dedup asset_id | stats count(eval(credentialed="true")) as with_sw count as total | eval coverage=round(with_sw/total*100,1) | fields coverage

table.title: New CVEs (click a CVE to open it in CVE response)

search.query: | eval check_platforms=mvjoin(check_platforms,", "), rapid7_checks=mvjoin(rapid7_checks,", ") | table cve title software platform check_platforms os_list severity cvss_v3 published added your_servers prod_dc prod_dr non_prod infra rapid7_checks | rename platform as "vendor / platform" check_platforms as "Rapid7 check platforms" os_list as "your servers' OS" prod_dc as "Prod · DC" prod_dr as "Prod · DR" non_prod as "Non-prod" infra as "INFRA"

table.title: Software inventory coverage by environment (servers with software data = credentialed scan or Insight Agent)

search.query: `r7_latest(rapid7:vm:asset_site)` | dedup asset_id | `r7_cmdb_enrich` | where cmdb_status="WORKING_ACTIVE" OR cmdb_status="NOT_IN_CMDB" | stats count as servers count(eval(credentialed="true")) as with_software_data by env_label | eval without=servers-with_software_data, coverage_pct=round(with_software_data/servers*100,1) | eval sort_order=case(env_label="Prod · DC",1, env_label="Prod · DR",2, like(env_label,"Non-prod%"),3, env_label="INFRA",4, true(),5) | sort sort_order env_label | fields - sort_order

| rest /servicesNS/-/rapid7_vm_cve/saved/searches splunk_server=local | search title IN ("Rapid7 CVE - recent checks lookup","Rapid7 CVE - recent hits lookup","Rapid7 CVE - vuln catalog","Rapid7 CVE - asset summary") | table title cron_schedule next_scheduled_time | append [| inputlookup r7_recent_checks.csv | stats count as rows | eval title="r7_recent_checks.csv (checks added in 30 days)"] | append [| inputlookup r7_recent_hits.csv | stats count as rows | eval title="r7_recent_hits.csv (server × CVE findings)"]
